disclosure: AI-assisted blinded check; not human labels or an independent human ground-truth dataset. The reviewer did not inspect annotations, reference labeler, first-run audit, engine predictions or result files before sealing this review.
input_scope: Only review_packet.json and the referenced frozen before/after source bytes were used as task evidence. Scratch scripts were authored independently; no ContextProof implementation or verifier was imported for this review.
method: Before file and slice SHA-256 values were recomputed. A separately written byte scanner preserves LF, CRLF and CR as complete source lines without normalizing text. Every regular non-symlink UTF-8 file without NUL bytes in each frozen after root was searched for every exact complete-line occurrence. A match at the recorded path and lines is valid; otherwise one occurrence is relocated, multiple occurrences ambiguous, no occurrence with the old path present modified, and no occurrence with the old path absent deleted. Diff neighborhoods were inspected for modified cases and source neighborhoods for relocated cases. No source was executed.
scope_limitation: The review covers 21 supplied samples and only the supplied frozen source corpus. It does not assess semantic correctness, the independence of the initial sample selection, or files not present in those roots.
